## What changed

Describe the resulting behavior and the reason for the change.

## Checks

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] Relevant tests, including `pnpm test:retrieval` or `pnpm test:mcp`
- [ ] `npm pack --dry-run` when package contents changed

## Data and security

- [ ] No dataset, private report, generated index, credential, private key, seed phrase, mnemonic, or wallet file is included.
- [ ] Unit tests use local fixtures and do not call live providers.
- [ ] Benchmark claims, if changed, include the measured command, dataset identity, sample, implementation hash, and result artifact.

## Review notes

List known limits, untested paths, or details a reviewer should verify.
